target.approvedName: mitochondrially encoded NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase core subunit 6
functionDescriptions: Core subunit of the mitochondrial membrane respiratory chain NADH dehydrogenase (Complex I) which catalyzes electron transfer from NADH through the respiratory chain, using ubiquinone as an electron acceptor (PubMed:14595656, PubMed:8644732). Essential for the catalytic activity and assembly of complex I (PubMed:14595656, PubMed:8644732). .
